The Interlocutor works a hook of cold iron into the bearer and names it a sacrament — a rite of pain that makes the unkillable killable. It cannot be pried loose; only something profound can cut it out.

Against Lord Veyrin (the gift). Your Strikes ignore Veyrin's physical resistances, and once you draw his blood his fast healing never returns.

The wound never closes (the cost). It reopens the moment the fight begins: when you roll initiative, the wound tears. Apply @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.effects.Item.nwWoundReopens01]{Effect: The Wound Reopens} (@Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage, flat DC 15 to end).

Impaling Chain 1

Frequency once per day

Cost each Strike tears you further — you take @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Effect You make a melee Impaling Chain Strike (added to your Strikes list): 2d8+7 piercing plus 1d6 persistent bleed, with the disarm, magical, reach, trip, and unholy traits; add your Strength to damage as with any melee weapon. On a critical hit, apply @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.effects.Item.nwImpalingChain1]{Effect: Impaling Chain}: the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and cannot recover from persistent bleed until it Escapes against your class DC or Athletics DC.
